description.zh-Hans: 这是一款以"牺牲与救赎"为核心的剧情向硬核平台跳跃游戏。玩家扮演一名守护者，需带领一位失忆的灵魂穿越充满陷阱与危机的梦境世界，通过收集七块"记忆碎片"来找回过往然后一同回家。
description.en: This is a story-driven hardcore platform jumping game centered on 'sacrifice and redemption'. Players play as a guardian who must lead an amnesiac soul through a dream world full of traps and dangers, collecting seven 'memory fragments' to recover the past and return home together.
